svg.title: AzureDevOpsDscNative resource mind map
svg.desc: The 84 DSC resources of AzureDevOpsDscNative, grouped by area. Projects & teams: AzDoProject, AzDoProjectServices, AzDoOrganizationSettings, AzDoProjectGroup, AzDoOrganizationGroup, AzDoGroupMember, AzDoTeam, AzDoTeamMember, AzDoTeamSettings, AzDoUserEntitlement, AzDoGroupEntitlement, AzDoServicePrincipalEntitlement; Repositories: AzDoGitRepository, AzDoRepositorySettings, AzDoBranchPolicy; Permissions: AzDoProjectPermission, AzDoOrganizationPermission, AzDoGitPermission, AzDoAreaPermission, AzDoIterationPermission, AzDoAgentPoolPermission, AzDoEnvironmentPermission, AzDoPipelinePermission, AzDoPipelineFolderPermission, AzDoServiceConnectionPermission, AzDoVariableGroupPermission, AzDoSecureFilePermission, AzDoArtifactFeedPermission, AzDoSecurityNamespacePermission, AzDoGroupPermission, AzDoQueryPermission, AzDoReleaseFolderPermission, AzDoReleaseDefinitionPermission, AzDoTaggingPermission, AzDoAnalyticsPermission, AzDoAnalyticsViewsPermission; Classic releases: AzDoReleaseFolder; Test management: AzDoTestVariable, AzDoTestConfiguration, AzDoTestPlan, AzDoTestSuite; Pipelines: AzDoPipeline, AzDoPipelineFolder, AzDoPipelineEnvironment, AzDoEnvironmentApproval, AzDoEnvironmentKubernetesResource, AzDoEnvironmentVMResource, AzDoCheckConfiguration, AzDoPipelineAuthorization, AzDoDeploymentGroup, AzDoDeploymentGroupTarget, AzDoAgentPool, AzDoAgentQueue, AzDoTaskGroup, AzDoTaskGroupPermission, AzDoVariableGroup, AzDoSecureFile, AzDoServiceConnection, AzDoPipelineSettings, AzDoBuildRetentionSettings; Boards: AzDoAreaNodes, AzDoIterationNodes, AzDoWIPTags, AzDoWIPTagHygiene, AzDoQueryFolder, AzDoWorkItemQuery, AzDoNotificationSubscription, AzDoDashboard; Process: AzDoProcess, AzDoPicklist, AzDoProcessWorkItemType, AzDoProcessField, AzDoProcessState, AzDoProcessRule, AzDoProcessBehavior, AzDoProcessPermission; Artifacts & more: AzDoArtifactFeed, AzDoArtifactFeedSettings, AzDoArtifactFeedView, AzDoWiki, AzDoWikiPage, AzDoExtension, AzDoAuditStream, AzDoServiceHook.

g.text: Names are shown without their AzDo prefix
